news.headline: ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 review shows no dose-dependent malignancy signal through Week 44
news.summary: An updated safety review of the Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance data found no dose-dependent malignancy signal for obefazimod through 44 weeks, easing a prior investor concern ahead of the planned NDA filing.

news.headline: TCG Crossover and INVUS Public Equities disclose large passive stakes in Abivax
news.summary: TCG Crossover Fund I reported beneficial ownership of about 5.7% (7.0% aggregate with affiliates) of Abivax ADSs, while INVUS Public Equities disclosed a 6% stake, underscoring continued institutional accumulation ahead of the NDA filing.

news.headline: Abivax announces positive pre-NDA interaction with the FDA for obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback aligning on Abivax's planned NDA content and submission strategy for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis; the company remains on track to submit its first NDA in late Q4 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley raises Abivax price target to $180 from $132
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its 12-month price target on ABVX to $180 from $132, citing growing confidence in the obefazimod regulatory and commercial path following the positive ABTECT maintenance data.

news.headline: Abivax strengthens commercial capabilities with strategic leadership appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders (marketing, patient services, sales, market access) drawn from Amgen, Takeda, AbbVie and Eli Lilly, building out the organization ahead of a planned U.S. launch of obefazimod.

news.headline: Abivax closes $920 million public offering
news.summary: Abivax closed its upsized ADS offering (7.36 million ADSs, including full underwriter over-allotment) for roughly $920 million gross / $874 million net proceeds, extending its cash runway into Q4 2029 to fund the planned U.S. commercialization of obefazimod.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA submission for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Following a positive pre-NDA meeting (Jul 30, 2026), Abivax plans to submit its first New Drug Application to the FDA in late Q4 2026.

catalysts.label: EMA marketing authorization application (MAA) filing
catalysts.detail: Abivax intends to file a MAA with the European Medicines Agency for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis in the second half of 2026, alongside the U.S. NDA.

catalysts.label: Lead combination-therapy candidate selection
catalysts.detail: Abivax plans to select a lead obefazimod combination candidate (paired with IL-23, a4b7, PDE-4, or AhR-targeting agents) to advance into development by year-end 2026.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease 12-week induction data
catalysts.detail: Topline induction readout from the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial of obefazimod in moderate-to-severely active Crohn's disease is expected mid-2027.

catalysts.label: Takeover / partnership speculation
catalysts.detail: Recurring market chatter about a potential large-pharma acquisition or partnership (e.g., earlier 2026 Eli Lilly speculation, denied by the company) continues to influence the stock; no confirmed deal as of Aug 25, 2026.

pulse: As of August 25, 2026, Abivax is in a quiet-news holding pattern after a strong run of positive catalysts: the Aug 19 safety review found no dose-dependent malignancy signal through Week 44, and heavy institutional buying (TCG Crossover, INVUS) plus a well-received FDA pre-NDA meeting (Jul 30) have kept sentiment and analyst price targets (Morgan Stanley $180, consensus ~$166-181) elevated. With ~$920M raised in July extending runway to Q4 2029 and a build-out of commercial leadership underway, the market's attention is now fixed on the confirmed late-Q4 2026 FDA NDA submission and a prospective H2 2026 EMA filing, with recurring takeover speculation still simmering in the background.
